name: Select, don't generate: the deadline
description: Code finds candidate dates in the email; Jev picks the one that is the actual payment deadline. Choice labels are the candidates, so the answer is always a real span. The candidate labels match the starting input set (invoice-email); for another email, replace them with the dates found in it.

deadline.instructions: Which of the candidate dates found in `email` is the payment deadline?

criteria.none: None of the candidates is a payment deadline

hasLateFee.instructions: Does `email` say a late fee applies if payment is late?
